name: @omni/design
description: The Omni Loop design system: the colour tokens and tokens.css, the fonts, the 16-bit crest logo, the Omni Loop brand, hand-placed pixel sprites and the planet renderer.

scripts.tokens: node --input-type=module -e "import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { tokensCss } from './src/tokens.ts'; writeFileSync('tokens.css', tokensCss());"
scripts.fonts: node --input-type=module -e "import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { fontsCss } from './src/fonts.ts'; writeFileSync('fonts.css', fontsCss());"
